notes.title: A global 1.2.0 update has been released for our game - Divine Help!
notes.content:
The main innovation of the version is the hint system, thanks to which you will never be stumped again!
Go and meet the Golden Herald at the top of the mountains above the clouds to receive a blessing from above. Until a certain time, you will be able to use free assistance every 5 minutes, but over time it will turn out that this has its consequences, which means that now you will have to pay a certain price.

Other innovations:
1. Added achievements "And death will not separate us" and "Comprehended Everything".
2. With a 5% chance of clicking on any spider, it will no longer escape, and the player will receive a new achievement.
3. The width of the text on the popup bar about receiving the achievement has been increased.
4. The Golden Messenger's mark on the map has been added, and the storyline with it has been changed.

In honor of the update, we have set a discount for you!

notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug that caused the opening event of a new element to not be triggered if it was purchased from characters in the Vice organization.
2. Correction of the Russian localization has been carried out.
3. The position of the buttons on the desktop has been changed, now they are arranged in the order of their appearance.
4. The first request for game statistics on Steam and VK Play now occurs during the initialization of the achievement system, rather than when receiving achievements directly.
5. When you click on the bowler hat (the button to remove simple items from the desktop), a warning now appears.
6. Improved item search. Now the element with the words in the name starting with the entered search word is shown more priority than the element with it in the middle. Also, elements with fewer letters in the name have a higher priority.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
1. Fixed a critical bug that caused the Fatal Knife to malfunction.
2. The Evangelyne task can now be completed once per game day.
3. Correction of the Russian localization has been carried out.
4. Fixed a critical bug that caused the clock in the pub to not work anyway after passing through the Catliff storyline.
5. Fixed a bug that made it impossible to get achievements with all watermelons.
6. On the fifth day of communication with Rat, the screen now goes dark in the cutscene.
7. The purchase of meowoculus from Darinettica is now located after the donation, and not at the end of the list of products.

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug that made it impossible to rename spiders and fish.
2. Fixed a bug where in the epilogue, if the player had exactly 125 pub levels, then Katrina didn't want to communicate.
3. Fixed a critical bug that made it impossible to get task achievements after the epilogue.
4. Increased web-weaving time by Ysma spiders.
5. Ysma's nametag is now worth 50 silk webs.
6. Fixed Kira's position at the first encounter with the player.
7. Correction of the Russian localization has been carried out.
8. The names of tasks with Mirror teas have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
1. Fixed a critical error due to which, when selling items from the desktop (Suns, Webs), if the corresponding items were both on the desktop and in the bag, a significant amount could be debited, taking the items from both the desktop and the bag.
2. Corrections of the text in the Russian localization.
3. In the delete elements menu, the name of the sunflower is written next to the flower pots, not the seeds planted in it.
4. In the delete elements menu, the list of elements no longer scrolls to the very beginning.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
1. The level of the "Calendar" element has been changed, now it can be made at level 23
2. Fixed a bug where you could get the "Cat Respect" achievement by refusing help for the first time, and then agreeing again
3. Fixed a bug that caused the animation of closing/opening various menus to hang under certain conditions.
4. Fixed a bug that caused the item counter on the desktop to incorrectly display the number of open items at one point.
5. Fixed some errors in the text
6. Fixed some errors in cutscenes
7. You can no longer put a Battered Bag in bags.
8. Added a bag that holds 32 elements
9. Bags have been moved from the Pub tab to the Legendary tab
10. Darineticca can now give away the Suns without buying anything.
11. Added a cutscene for Darinettica if the player has at least 20 suns on the alchemy table to give the player a special bag.
12. 703 new crafts have been added to the game.
13. Darinettica's shopping list no longer scrolls up after each purchase.
14. Added a warning when changing the language that translation work is underway.
15. Now, in the cellar, the exit button on the map will not disappear, but will become inactive by clicking on it, you can get any phrase.
16. Fixed an issue where some of the meowoculus in the pub could not be collected
17. The levels for crafting some items That were impossible to craft because of it were changed.se of it.
18. Meowoculus is now displayed in the items menu
19. The receipt of the first meowoculus and the opening of the Snow Ridge have been changed
20. Additional random Mirror phrases have been added
21. Now, when a legendary rat rolls, there is a 30% chance that a mythical rat will roll.
22. There are now Meowocules in Rin's house.
23. Up to 2 meowocules can now appear in the locations of the Cat and the Master.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
1. Mr. Letter is now displayed in the message archive
2. Sparrow's tasks can now only be completed if the Sparrow is open.
3. The alchemy exam now displays a button for the closed elements menu, if you click on it in this state, the dialogue will play.
4. Kira's position in the cutscene has been fixed upon first acquaintance
5. Fixed a bug that caused the desired cursor to not be set when logging into the game/save.
6. Fixed a bug that caused the cursor from a previous save to be saved and moved to any other save when you entered the save menu.
7. Fixed a bug that caused the meowoculus that appeared in the settings menu to persist there even after exiting the save.
8. Sunflowers planted in a pot are now labeled as sunflowers, not seeds.
9. Fixed errors in Russian localization
10. Improved the text of the following characters in the Russian localization: Kostya, Jimmy, Emily, Faust, Catliff, Ysma, Luna, Kuki, Ruta
11. Added clarifications about the work of Sunflowers in the descriptions of their seeds
12. Fixed a bug where when collecting meowoculus and quickly trying to close the menu with this meowoculus, the menu could freeze up.
13. The second copy of "Chimera" has been removed from the item menu
14. Increased the width of the text of the name of all elements

notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.content:
1. Added additional recipes for creating elements: Rain, Knife, Electric Stingray, Phoenix
2. Correcting errors in the text
3. Fixed a bug that made it impossible to open one of the quest branches in Chapter 4.
4. The text of the following characters has been improved: Catrina, Sam, Black, Stasyan, Alisa Pestsova
5. Added 10 random phrases for Alisa Pestsova

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
1. Fixed errors in cutscenes
2. Fixed errors in the text
3. Mr. Email is now displayed in the message archive
4. The animation preloading setting has been removed
5. The "Snake Eyes" achievement has been removed due to the inability to obtain it.
